title: Decision-readiness table: one row per brief requirement, with the gate that blocks it and the number that would clear it

how_to_read.requirement: The requirement, quoted in the same words as the brief (grouped where the brief states the same thing twice).
how_to_read.state: met = implemented and re-verified this session; partial = implemented but limited by a documented evidence gap; blocked = cannot be completed from official sources as currently held; not_started = no implementation found in the repository.
how_to_read.blocking_gate: The single next thing that must be true for the requirement to advance. Named after the owner's own gate vocabulary where one exists.
how_to_read.clearing_number: The measurable quantity that would clear the gate, stated as a target with its current value. Where the value cannot be measured yet the cell says so and is blank-marked rather than guessed.
how_to_read.ask: The specific question the owner must answer, or the specific artefact that must be acquired, to move the row.

rows.requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.blocking_gate: G7 price-verified: needs an official or contractually licensed open/close feed
rows.clearing_number: 3 markets x 13 Week 11 fixtures = 39 snapshot pairs, of which 39 have fair values and 0 have a sourced market value (the NFL publishes no prices)
rows.ask: Choose the licensed price vendor, or accept permanently blank market columns and rename the store 'our-fair-line-only'.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/data/price_snapshots.json; this session re-read the Week 11 schedule page (nfl.com publishes kickoff/network but never a line)

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.blocking_gate: Same as A01: a residual needs both terms; only one term exists
rows.clearing_number: 1 residual per fixture per market = 39/week; currently 0 publishable because the market term is null
rows.ask: Same decision as A01. Until then publish 'our fair line vs last week's line' as an explicitly non-market baseline.
rows.evidence: nfl-book engine/originate.py computes fair lines only

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.blocking_gate: G7 price-verified
rows.clearing_number: 3 separate columns exist per market; fair is populated on 13/13 fixtures, market and difference on 0/13
rows.ask: A01 decision. The columns are already correct; only the middle term is missing.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/pages/own-lines.html, three adjacent columns per market

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.blocking_gate: None — order is a code property and is asserted on every row
rows.clearing_number: 13/13 Week 11 fixtures record origination_order = [side, total, moneyline]; verifier rejects any row that deviates
rows.ask: Nothing. Keep the assertion in the build.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/engine/verify.py asserts the order on both open and close snapshots

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.blocking_gate: This is a decision, not a build. It is the root blocker for A01-A03 and every ROI figure
rows.clearing_number: 1 written policy naming the price source, the snapshot clock and the settlement rule; 0 exist
rows.ask: Answer Q01 and Q02 below. Nothing downstream should publish an ROI until this is written.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/data/flags.json FB-01/FB-02 record that all staking uses an ASSUMED -110 price

rows.requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.blocking_gate: None for existence; a completeness gate remains on the un-reread fraction
rows.clearing_number: 137 settled games with a per-row official URL. Independently re-checked this session: 9/9 Week 10 finals match the official scoreboard
rows.ask: Nothing. The feed exists and agrees.

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.blocking_gate: G3 pre-registration integrity: the corpus grew from 136 to 137 after registration
rows.clearing_number: 137 rows now vs 136 registered. 1 game was added to a frozen corpus, so the registration no longer matches the file
rows.ask: Re-freeze the corpus with a dated commit and record the hash, or state in the registration that the corpus is 'all settled games as of capture'.

rows.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
rows.blocking_gate: No prior-season official results are held; only 2026 weeks 1-10
rows.clearing_number: Need 2+ prior seasons of official game results; currently 0 prior seasons, 137 games all from one season
rows.ask: Acquire prior-season nfl.com results into a dated same-shape feed so a holdout season exists.

rows.requirement: Compute and publish the 'removal of luck' panel on the site dashboard
rows.blocking_gate: G4 placebo/permutation test runs but on n=105 forecasts from one season
rows.clearing_number: Permutation p is published as 0/500 draws (flag FB-16). A p of exactly 0 on n=105 is a resolution floor, not evidence
rows.ask: Report p as '< 0.002 (1/500)' and add a second, independent season before calling anything skill.

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.blocking_gate: None — enforced in code
rows.clearing_number: 5/5 registered strategies carry a frozen rule and threshold; leaderboard awards 0 points while G7 is blocked (amendment A1)
rows.ask: Nothing. The defect to guard is drift: the registry must be re-hashed at every evaluation.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/data/strategies.json + engine/verify.py refuses points while G7 fails

rows.requirement: Pre-register each strategy (definition frozen before results are seen) / Freeze a rule before it sees data
rows.blocking_gate: None — the commit is the registration
rows.clearing_number: registered_utc 2026-11-14T00:00Z precedes the first backtest run in git history
rows.ask: Nothing. Publish the commit hash next to each strategy.

rows.requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.blocking_gate: None — staking columns never rank
rows.clearing_number: Ranking key is signal tier then signal metric; staking ROI is displayed and never sorts
rows.ask: Nothing. Add a guard test that fails if ROI becomes a sort key.

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
rows.blocking_gate: G2 needs a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment over the number of trials
rows.clearing_number: Brier skill is computed; cluster CI95 is published for some rows and blank for others; no multiplicity adjustment yet
rows.ask: Publish, for every strategy, the Brier skill with a game-clustered bootstrap lower bound and a Benjamini-Hochberg q across all trials.

rows.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions (singles, game parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos)
rows.blocking_gate: Needs at least one validated member of more than one division
rows.clearing_number: 4 divisions; 3 have zero eligible strategies; 1 division (singles) has 5 candidates all failing a gate
rows.ask: Nothing to rank yet. Build the division labels into the table now so the first eligible row lands correctly.
rows.evidence: nfl-book/data/strategies.json families (3 declared; same-game parlays are folded into parlays)

rows.requirement: Add a control baseline (random picks; favorites only) to every leaderboard run

rows.clearing_number: 0.6346 published as a per-week favorites baseline; flag FB-14 records that it was not pre-registered
rows.ask: Re-register the baseline rule with a dated commit, then rerun. Until then the comparison is descriptive.

rows.blocking_gate: G8 legal review + G7 price-verified: no reward may be paid on unverified prices
rows.clearing_number: Points pool 1,000; awarded 0. The blocking count is 0 validated strategies, not 0 points
rows.ask: Answer Q08 and Q13. Rewards cannot be funded before both.

rows.clearing_number: Stage 1 gates are implemented; stage 2 escrow has 0 observable events because there is no close price
rows.ask: A01 decision. CLV is undefined without a close.

rows.clearing_number: 1 joint-probability gate; 0 parlays pass it; 1 prop strategy (S5) permanently blocked (flag FB-05)
